  "check_code": "import sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\ndef _db(ws):\n    return Path(ws).parent / \"system\" / \"microsoft_power_approvals\" / \"state.db\"\n\n\ndef check_replacement_request(ws):\n    with sqlite3.connect(_db(ws)) as con:\n        con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n        rows = con.execute(\n            \"\"\"SELECT * FROM approval_requests\n               WHERE agency_id = ? AND external_claim_id = ?\"\"\",\n            (\"SCV-WATER\", \"CLM-SCV-2024-0831-R1\"),\n        ).fetchall()\n    if len(rows) != 1:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"expected exactly one resubmission request, found {len(rows)}\"}\n    row = dict(rows[0])\n    expected = {\n        \"agency_id\": \"SCV-WATER\",\n        \"external_claim_id\": \"CLM-SCV-2024-0831-R1\",\n        \"policy_id\": \"SCV-POL-EMP-MANUAL-S28-2016-06\",\n        \"requester_employee_id\": \"EMP-SCV-1007\",\n        \"requester_display_name\": \"Sarah Chen\",\n        \"requester_department_code\": \"FIN\",\n        \"requester_is_department_manager\": 1,\n        \"request_type\": \"REIMBURSEMENT\",\n        \"regular_meeting_flag\": 0,\n        \"required_role_code\": \"GENERAL_MANAGER\",\n        \"request_amount_cents\": 31200,\n        \"required_prior_approval_at\": \"2024-08-20T17:00:00Z\",\n        \"final_status\": \"PENDING\",\n    }\n    mismatches = [f\"{key}={row.get(key)!r}\" for key, value in expected.items() if row.get(key) != value]\n    note = row.get(\"request_note\") or \"\"\n    if \"CLM-SCV-2024-0831\" not in note or \"AR-SCV-2024-0312\" not in note:\n        mismatches.append(\"request_note does not link original claim and request\")\n    if mismatches:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"; \".join(mismatches)}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": f\"replacement request {row['approval_request_id']} has the required pending GM route and amount\"}\n\n\ndef check_replacement_submission_event(ws):\n    with sqlite3.connect(_db(ws)) as con:\n        con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n        request = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT approval_request_id FROM approval_requests WHERE agency_id=? AND external_claim_id=?\",\n            (\"SCV-WATER\", \"CLM-SCV-2024-0831-R1\"),\n        ).fetchone()\n        if request is None:\n            return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"replacement request not found\"}\n        events = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM approval_events WHERE approval_request_id=? ORDER BY sequence_no\",\n            (request[\"approval_request_id\"],),\n        ).fetchall()\n    if len(events) != 1:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"expected one initial submission event, found {len(events)}\"}\n    event = dict(events[0])\n    expected = {\n        \"sequence_no\": 1,\n        \"event_type\": \"SUBMISSION\",\n        \"actor_role_code\": \"REQUESTER\",\n        \"event_outcome\": \"SUBMITTED\",\n        \"signature_captured_flag\": 0,\n    }\n    mismatches = [f\"{key}={event.get(key)!r}\" for key, value in expected.items() if event.get(key) != value]\n    if mismatches:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"; \".join(mismatches)}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"replacement request has an immutable submission event\"}\n\n\ndef check_original_request_preserved(ws):\n    with sqlite3.connect(_db(ws)) as con:\n        con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n        request = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT approval_request_id, external_claim_id, final_status, request_amount_cents FROM approval_requests WHERE approval_request_id=?\",\n            (\"AR-SCV-2024-0312\",),\n        ).fetchone()\n        events = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT approval_event_id FROM approval_events WHERE approval_request_id=? ORDER BY sequence_no\",\n            (\"AR-SCV-2024-0312\",),\n        ).fetchall()\n    expected_ids = [\"AE-SCV-0312-01\", \"AE-SCV-0312-02\", \"AE-SCV-0312-03\", \"AE-SCV-0312-04\"]\n    if request is None:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"original request was deleted\"}\n    if dict(request) != {\n        \"approval_request_id\": \"AR-SCV-2024-0312\",\n        \"external_claim_id\": \"CLM-SCV-2024-0831\",\n        \"final_status\": \"APPROVED\",\n        \"request_amount_cents\": 31200,\n    }:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"original request fields changed\"}\n    actual_ids = [row[\"approval_event_id\"] for row in events]\n    if actual_ids != expected_ids:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"original immutable event history changed\"}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"original request and its four events remain unchanged\"}\n",
